Talia: FYI noticed customers hitting silent retries. SDKs weren't surfacing the server retry hint header so apps retried too aggressively.
Ben: which header is that? we have X-Redwood-Retry but maybe inconsistent across services.
Talia: saw X-Redwood-Retry: 30s on one route, missing on fallback route. payload returned 200 so client thought all good.
Ravi: we should formalize a small contract: X-Redwood-Retry-Hint (seconds|none), X-Redwood-Landing (enum), and a machine subcode in response body `subcode`.
Ben: agree. also add `retry_action` enum: immediate_backoff | delayed | no_retry. avoids parsing numbers.
Liz (devex): from UX side console should surface "recommended client action" mapping to the same enum. map `delayed` -> show "Try again in ~30s" and a retry button. map `no_retry` -> banner "quota exceeded" with upgrade link.
Talia: telemetry ask: tag traces with `retry_hint` and `landing_subcode` so we can graph how often quick retries happen and correlate with increased request volume.
Ravi: telemetry: also increment a counter `client_retry_suggested_total{hint="delayed"}` and a counter for `client_retry_performed_total` so we can measure adherence.
Ben: backcompat: headers are additive. older SDKs ignore unknown enums. new SDKs should expose a `getRetryHint()` accessor returning structured object.
Liz (devex): small copy suggestion for console: "Automatic fallback applied — we served a smaller model to preserve latency. Recommended action: wait 30s or upgrade plan." keep language consistent with support playbook.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Feature flags updated: retry-hint-headers ON for canary at 2026-03-21T16:45:00Z
Talia: QA checklist: 1) header present on all routes that can trigger fallback 2) body subcode present 3) metric emitted 4) console banner shows corresponding hint.
Ravi: i'll draft the RFC for header names + enum vocab + metric names. will include sample curl and pseudo-sdk snippet.
Ben: quick curl example for the RFC:
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
# -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# X-Redwood-Landing: capacity_fallback
# X-Redwood-Retry-Hint: 30s
# body: {"subcode":"capacity_fallback","content":"..."}
```
Liz (devex): i'll prototype the console banner variations and a small support flowcard. we'll iterate after RFC.
Talia: thanks team. please drop any critical objections here, otherwise i'll link RFC and smaller PRs to the canary deploy.
